post.summary: Promises a video upload for a movie or an episode, or a trailer for a movie or a series, and returns where to send the file.
Says the file is uploaded; the video is then converted in the background.

get.summary: Returns a video with its renditions, or why it could not be converted.

post.summary: Promises the upload of a dub for a converted video and returns where to send the file.
Says the dub is uploaded; it is then converted in the background.

delete.summary: Takes a dub off the video; the original sound cannot be removed.

post.summary: Promises the upload of subtitles (WebVTT or SRT) for a converted video and returns where to send the file.
Says the subtitles are uploaded: they are checked, turned into WebVTT and offered to players at once.
Starts watching a movie or an episode with a profile; returns the master playlist, relative to this address.
Keeps the session live; without one for two minutes it ends. Fails, and ends it, when watching is no longer allowed.

delete.summary: Stops watching, at the position given; the screen is free at once.

get.summary: How far the profile has watched each movie or episode of a title.
What the profile was watching, most recent first: the movie or episode to go on with, and where.
The session's master playlist: the renditions its plan allows.
One rendition's playlist, its segments as short-lived storage addresses.
One language of the sound: its playlist, the segments as short-lived storage addresses.
One language of subtitles: a playlist of the WebVTT file as a short-lived storage address.
The newest trailer of a movie or a series that can be watched: a signed master playlist address.
A trailer's master playlist: its renditions and its sound.
One rendition of a trailer, its segments as short-lived storage addresses.
A trailer's sound, its segments as short-lived storage addresses.
The titles on the profile's list that it can watch now, most recently added first.

put.summary: Puts a title the profile can watch on its list; one already there stays. At most 200 titles.

delete.summary: Takes a title off the profile's list; one that is not there changes nothing.

get.summary: The languages of sound and subtitles the profile last chose.

put.summary: Keeps the profile's choice; its next sessions start with it where the video offers the language.
